$comment: clients-history-summary-and-risk (design D1): every client carries its churn risk, a level with the named signals that produced it, written by ClientRiskService (daily through ClientRiskJob, and at once when a contract status or a survey classification changes). Stored rather than computed on read, because the Clients list sorts and filters on it. Never typed by hand, so read only in forms. client 1.6.0 -> 1.7.0.

churnRisk.title: Risk
churnRisk.description: How likely the client is to leave: low, medium or high, with the signals behind it. Recomputed by pipelinq.

score.title: Risk score
score.description: The points of all signals added up.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: The signals behind the level, each with its points and records.

points.title: Points
points.description: What this signal adds to the score.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema of the records behind this signal.

computedAt.title: Computed at
computedAt.description: When the risk was last computed.
